verses.text: Christ set us free so we could live in freedom. So stand firm, and don't let anyone tie you up again in slavery.
Listen, I, Paul, am telling you: if you get circumcised as a requirement, Christ won't benefit you.
I testify again to every man who gets circumcised: he is obligated to obey the whole law.
You who are trying to be made right by the law have cut yourselves off from Christ; you've fallen away from grace.
But through the Spirit, by faith, we eagerly wait for the hope of righteousness.
In Christ Jesus, circumcision and uncircumcision mean nothing. What matters is faith expressing itself through love.
You were running a great race! Who cut in on you and kept you from obeying the truth?
That kind of persuasion doesn't come from the one who called you.
A little yeast spreads through the whole batch.
I'm confident in the Lord that you'll come around to the right view. But whoever is confusing you will face judgment, whoever they are.
Brothers and sisters, if I still preached circumcision, why am I still persecuted? Then the cross wouldn't be a stumbling block anymore.
I wish those who are upsetting you would go all the way and mutilate themselves!
You were called to freedom, brothers and sisters. But don't use your freedom to indulge your human nature. Instead, serve one another through love.
The whole law is summed up in one command: ‘Love your neighbor as yourself.’
But if you keep biting and devouring one another, watch out or you'll destroy each other.
So I say: live by the Spirit, and you won't carry out the desires of your human nature.
Our human nature desires what opposes the Spirit, and the Spirit desires what opposes our human nature. They're opposed to each other, so you can't just do whatever you want.
But if the Spirit leads you, you're not under the law.
The works of our human nature are obvious: sexual immorality, impurity, and reckless behavior;
idolatry, sorcery, hatred, fighting, jealousy, angry outbursts, selfish ambition, division, and factions;
envy, murder, drunkenness, wild partying, and things like these. I'm warning you, as I warned you before: people who practice such things won't inherit God's Kingdom.
But the Spirit produces love, joy, peace, patience, kindness, goodness, faithfulness,
gentleness, and self-control. There is no law against these things.
Those who belong to Christ Jesus have crucified their human nature, along with its passions and desires.
Since we live by the Spirit, let's keep in step with the Spirit too.
Let's not become conceited, provoking and envying one another.
